function backgroundRepeatCase(v) {
  document.body.innerHTML='';document.body.style.cssText='margin:0';
  const parent=document.createElement('main');document.body.append(parent);
  const sheet=document.createElement('style');document.head.append(sheet);
  const e=document.createElement('div');e.id='target';parent.append(e);const s=getComputedStyle(e),checks={};
  const check=(name,css,expected,rules='')=>{sheet.textContent=rules;e.style.cssText='width:40px;height:10px;'+css;checks[name]=s.backgroundRepeat===expected&&s.getPropertyValue('background-repeat')===expected&&e.getBoundingClientRect().width===40&&e.getBoundingClientRect().height===10;};
  check('default','','repeat');check('repeat','background-repeat:repeat','repeat');check('none','background-repeat:no-repeat','no-repeat');check('space','background-repeat:space','space');check('round','background-repeat:round','round');check('x','background-repeat:repeat-x','repeat-x');check('y','background-repeat:repeat-y','repeat-y');
  const pairs=[['repeat repeat','repeat'],['repeat no-repeat','repeat-x'],['no-repeat repeat','repeat-y'],['no-repeat no-repeat','no-repeat'],['repeat space','repeat space'],['repeat round','repeat round'],['space repeat','space repeat'],['space no-repeat','space no-repeat'],['space space','space'],['space round','space round'],['round repeat','round repeat'],['round no-repeat','round no-repeat'],['round space','round space'],['round round','round'],['no-repeat space','no-repeat space'],['no-repeat round','no-repeat round']];
  for(let i=0;i<pairs.length;i++)check('pair'+i,'background-repeat:'+pairs[i][0],pairs[i][1]);
  const pair=pairs[v%pairs.length],count=v%7+1;
  check('variantLayers','background-image:'+Array(count).fill('none').join(',')+';background-repeat:'+pair[0],Array(count).fill(pair[1]).join(', '));
  check('cycleLayers','background-image:none,none,none;background-repeat:repeat-x,space round','repeat-x, space round, repeat-x');
  check('trimLayers','background-repeat:repeat-y,space round','repeat-y');
  check('defaultLayers','background-image:none,none,none','repeat, repeat, repeat');
  check('variable','--repeat:'+pair[0]+';background-repeat:var(--repeat)',pair[1]);check('fallback','background-repeat:var(--missing,space round)','space round');check('invalidVariable','background-repeat:var(--missing)','repeat');check('invalidVariableValue','--repeat:20px;background-repeat:var(--repeat)','repeat');
  check('specificity','','round','div{background-repeat:space}#target{background-repeat:round}');check('sourceOrder','','round','#target{background-repeat:space}#target{background-repeat:round}');check('inlineOrigin','background-repeat:no-repeat','no-repeat','#target{background-repeat:round}');check('important','background-repeat:no-repeat','round','#target{background-repeat:round!important}');
  check('layers','','round','@layer early,late;@layer early{#target{background-repeat:space}}@layer late{div{background-repeat:round}}');check('importantLayers','','space','@layer early,late;@layer early{div{background-repeat:space!important}}@layer late{#target{background-repeat:round!important}}');
  sheet.textContent='';parent.style.cssText='background-image:none;background-repeat:repeat-x,round';check('notInherited','','repeat');check('inherit','background-image:none,none,none;background-repeat:inherit','repeat-x, repeat-x, repeat-x');parent.style.backgroundImage='none,none,none';check('inheritUnexpanded','background-image:none,none,none,none,none;background-repeat:inherit','repeat-x, round, repeat-x, round, repeat-x');parent.style.backgroundImage='none';checks.liveParentCount=s.backgroundRepeat==='repeat-x, repeat-x, repeat-x, repeat-x, repeat-x';check('unset','background-repeat:unset','repeat');check('initial','background-repeat:initial','repeat');check('revert','background-repeat:revert','repeat');
  check('registered','background-repeat:var(--registered)','round','@property --registered{syntax:"<custom-ident>";inherits:false;initial-value:round}');
  check('escaped','background-repeat:round;background-repeat:re\\70 eat','repeat');check('uppercase','background-repeat:SPACE ROUND','space round');
  sheet.textContent='';e.style.cssText='background-repeat:round';e.style.backgroundRepeat='20px';checks.invalidKeyword=s.backgroundRepeat==='round';e.style.backgroundRepeat='repeat-x repeat-y';checks.invalidPair=s.backgroundRepeat==='round';e.style.backgroundRepeat='repeat,';checks.invalidList=s.backgroundRepeat==='round';
  e.style.setProperty('BACKGROUND-REPEAT','space round','important');checks.cssom=s.backgroundRepeat==='space round'&&e.style.getPropertyPriority('background-repeat')==='important';checks.removal=e.style.removeProperty('background-repeat')==='space round'&&s.backgroundRepeat==='repeat';
  e.style.cssText='background-repeat:repeat-x,round';checks.liveTrim=s.backgroundRepeat==='repeat-x';e.style.backgroundImage='none,none,none';checks.liveLayerCount=s.backgroundRepeat==='repeat-x, round, repeat-x';e.style.backgroundRepeat='space round';checks.liveValue=s.backgroundRepeat==='space round, space round, space round';
  e.style.cssText='';sheet.textContent='#target{background-repeat:space}';checks.liveSheet=s.backgroundRepeat==='space';sheet.textContent='#target{background-repeat:round}';checks.liveSheetMutation=s.backgroundRepeat==='round';
  const external=document.createElement('div');external.id='external';parent.append(external);checks.external=getComputedStyle(external).backgroundRepeat===(v%2?'repeat-y':'repeat-x');
  sheet.textContent='';e.style.background='none repeat-x';checks.shorthand=s.backgroundRepeat==='repeat-x';e.style.background='none';checks.shorthandReset=s.backgroundRepeat==='repeat';
  const throws=(fn,name)=>{try{fn();return false;}catch(e){return e.name===name;}};checks.readOnly=throws(()=>{s.backgroundRepeat='space'},'NoModificationAllowedError');checks.priority=s.getPropertyPriority('background-repeat')==='';checks.uppercaseRead=s.getPropertyValue('BACKGROUND-REPEAT')==='repeat';checks.enumeration=Array.from({length:s.length},(_,i)=>s.item(i)).filter(name=>name==='background-repeat').length===1;
  e.remove();checks.detached=s.backgroundRepeat==='';parent.append(e);checks.reattached=s.backgroundRepeat==='repeat';
  sheet.remove();return checks;
}
